title: Variationally correct physics-informed operator learning for nonlinear partial differential equations
abstract: arXiv:2611.21469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-informed operator learning trains neural operators on the residual of a parametric partial differential equation (PDE) instead of labeled solution data, but its reliability depends on a variationally correct residual: one that is equivalent to the error in a norm dictated by the equation, the PDE-compliant norm. For nonlinear equations written as first-order systems, we prove that the first-order system least-squares residual is equivalent to the error in this norm near a solution branch if the linearized residual is stable and the residual derivative is Lipschitz continuous, possibly in a norm stronger than the error norm. We verify these conditions for monotone reaction, solution- and gradient-dependent diffusion, and compressible Neo-Hookean hyperelasticity. The stability mechanisms vary across these classes, as do the regions where the equivalence holds, from arbitrary bounded sets to a neighborhood of the branch. In a conf

translated_title: 面向非线性偏微分方程的变分正确物理信息算子学习
translated_abstract: 物理信息算子学习通过参数化偏微分方程（PDE）的残差而非标注解数据来训练神经算子，但其可靠性依赖于一个变分正确的残差，即该残差与由方程所规定的范数（PDE相容范数）度量的误差等价。对于写成一阶系统的非线性方程，我们证明：若线性化残差稳定，且残差导数满足Lipschitz连续（可能在强于误差范数的范数意义下），则一阶系统最小二乘残差在解分支附近与该范数下的误差等价。我们对单调反应项、依赖解与梯度的扩散项以及可压缩Neo-Hookean超弹性模型验证了这些条件。这些类别之间的稳定性机制各不相同，等价性成立的区域也各不相同，从任意有界集合到解分支的邻域。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了在稳定性与Lipschitz条件下，一阶系统最小二乘残差在解分支附近与PDE相容范数下的误差等价，从而为非线性偏微分方程的物理信息算子学习建立了变分正确性理论保证，并在单调反应、解与梯度依赖扩散及可压缩超弹性等多类问题上验证了该理论。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the first-order system least-squares residual is variationally correct—equivalent to the error in the PDE-compliant norm near a solution branch—under linearized stability and Lipschitz continuity conditions, and verifies these conditions for monotone reaction, solution- and gradient-dependent diffusion, and compressible Neo-Hookean hyperelasticity.
